hero.title: We craft digital experiences that make brands impossible to ignore
hero.label: Creative studio — Est. 2021

intro.title: Ideas that burn bright, built to last
intro.body: StudioCrea is a creative studio that fuses brand thinking, design and technology. We turn bold ideas into identities, websites and motion that people feel — and remember.

work.title: Featured Work
work.body: A selection of projects where strategy met craft — and the results spoke for themselves.

services.statement: We shape brands from the first spark to the final pixel — strategy, identity, digital and motion under one roof, so every touchpoint feels like the same fire.

about.title: A studio built on curiosity, craft and a little bit of fire
about.body1: We started StudioCrea with a simple belief: the brands people love are the ones that make them feel something. Since then we've partnered with founders, marketers and global teams to build work that is as strategic as it is beautiful.
about.body2: We're a compact team of strategists, designers, developers and motion artists. No layers, no hand-offs into the void — just the people doing the work, working closely with you.

values.title: Spark
values.body: We dig into your business, audience and market until the idea is undeniable.

values.title: Shape
values.body: We design and prototype fast, testing in motion and in context — not just in slides.

values.title: Ship
values.body: We build with performance and accessibility in mind, then launch and keep improving.

projects.title: Work we're proud of
projects.challengeBody: The brand needed to stand out in a crowded market and connect with a younger, digital-first audience without losing the trust it had built over the years.
projects.approachBody: We built a flexible visual system around a single, ownable idea, then brought it to life across digital, motion and physical touchpoints with one consistent voice.

contact.title: Let's start something bold
